card.name: Digits inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a digit right after it (or after a leading 0) inside a number such as 2.56, 0.05 or 1.2. It appears in doses, ratios, lab values and statistics.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The point itself between whole and fractional digits.

modes.label: Digit after the point
modes.description: The first fractional digit, often after 0. or 2.
